name: PDF Form Field Lister and Filler

seo.title: PDF Form Field Lister and Filler — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: List common AcroForm fields, edit supported values locally and export a filled PDF.

assumptions: Unknown field types are shown read-only instead of being guessed.
limitations: XFA-only forms, JavaScript-driven calculations and signed forms may not behave as expected after editing.
